question: Does the official wide-field Subaru BVRIz/BPZ catalog contain the baryonic structure needed to audit the broad southern MACS1931 lens-halo endpoint?
selection_boundary: MACS1931 was selected before this acquisition because its second Lenstool halo is the only one of seven reconstructed components whose capacity-relaxed dominant origin remains more than 400 kpc from a published member after restoring the full existing member catalog.
The archive directory, three text products, expected byte lengths, and raw-only acquisition rule were frozen before any complete catalog was downloaded or spatially scored.
Remote inspection was limited to the archive listing, HTTP metadata, the README, and leading comment/schema lines. No complete catalog rows were examined.
This acquisition cannot establish a gravity-routing effect. A separate frozen analysis protocol controls membership, target, null rotations, and interpretation.

official_source.documentation_claim: The archive README describes a 40 by 40 arcmin co-added BVRIz catalog and BPZ photometric redshifts; the scientific reduction is attributed there to Umetsu et al. (2014).
